A3_S2_D2: ^Narrator: The creature in front of you boasts of an impressive size. You take a moment to figure out how to start the conversation, before noticing that something’s tangled in its wings.
^Noelle: Um… Would you like help with that?
^Dragonfly: Oh, sure! I was just gonna break it off, but this’ll save the little ones the trouble of collecting new vines.
^Narrator: The dragonfly finally steps back to take a proper look at you, then Amelia, before humming with intrigue.
^Dragonfly: Oh… you must be visiting the Viridi.
^Heli: Well, nice to meet you! I’m Heli, one of the locals that comes and goes delivering items, since I’ve got—
^Narrator: He flaps his wings. The vine tangled in it flops with the motion.

^Heli: —These. Sometimes, young creatures want to experience flying over the island, so they make makeshift harnesses that are a little hard to take off without thumbs. So I just break them if they get tangled.
^Narrator: Amelia scrutinizes Heli, raising herself into a bipedal position before she hops and chomps through the vine on the creature’s wings.
^Narrator: It falls off cleanly. Amelia lands on the grass with a light hop.
^Narrator: After you explain the case of the missing calf, Heli reports that while he's been picking up a lot of stray after the storm a few days ago, he hasn't spotted a monsteratops.
^Noelle: It’s alright. Thanks for letting us know.
^Heli: I’d take you on a quick spin to look, but it’d be dangerous if an untrained humanoid fell from that height.
^Heli: But rest assured! I’ll let the Viridi know if I spot him. They’re pretty well-known for their ties to the land, after all.
